title: NullWorld
description: This mod adds the truly legendary entity named Null. Play this mod at your own risk...
body:
**Overview**

NullWorld is a psychological horror mod for Minecraft that introduces a mysterious and aggressive entity known as **Null**. Unlike standard mobs, Null is designed to stalk the player, creating an atmosphere of constant paranoia and unpredictability.



**Key Features:**

- **Dynamic Stalking System:** Null doesn't just attack; he watches. You might spot him in the distance, behind trees, or at the edge of your render distance before he vanishes.
- **Multi-Phase Progression:** The horror escalates over time. The mod features several distinct phases of Null's behavior, moving from passive observation to active psychological manipulation and eventually direct confrontation.
- **Randomized Horror Events:** Experience unique world events, such as sudden atmospheric changes, strange sounds, and eerie structures that appear when you least expect them.
- **Custom AI and Entities:** Featuring unique animations and AI logic to make the encounters feel "supernatural" and different from vanilla Minecraft entities.



**How it Affects Gameplay:**

NullWorld transforms the peaceful survival experience into a survival-horror challenge. Players must stay alert even during routine tasks like mining or building. Every shadow could be a threat, forcing you to change how you explore and interact with your world.



**Development Status:**

The mod is currently in **active development.** As I am working on expanding the phases and events, you may encounter some bugs or performance issues. Feedback is highly appreciated!

**I have a Telegram Channel where you can see all the important information!!** https://t.me/MelN_IK_Minecraft
